name: Biển Hồ shrimp
summary: Small shrimp from Biển Hồ, seasoned and dried on rice paper into a thin sheet.
origin: The river-food article lists tép Biển Hồ with phở khô, grilled chicken and bamboo rice, sun-dried beef, heo sọc dưa, and cassava leaf with bitter eggplant. The only method in that article is the rice-paper one.
howToEat: Season the shrimp and spread them on rice paper, then dry the sheet. The same idea later became the Sê San anchovy cracker.
where: Biển Hồ, the lake north of Pleiku.
seoTitle: Biển Hồ shrimp dried on rice paper
seoDescription: Tép Biển Hồ is small lake shrimp, seasoned and dried on rice paper into a thin sheet.
